name: linear_baseline_dcan_v1

validation.site: leave-one-site-out over every site with both classes; single-class sites are training-only
validation.institution: leave-one-institution-out: all cohorts of an institution (ABIDE I and II, numbered sub-sites) are held out together; see INSTITUTIONS in neuroasd/linear_baseline.py

model_selection: ridge strength by inner CV grouped like the outer split (AUC); no test-fold selection
